b1-haromresz-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Kings and Diets
b1-haromresz-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks how Royal Hungary was governed under the Habsburg kings.
b1-haromresz-01.prompt: Tell the official which dynasty the kings of Royal Hungary came from and where the diets met.
cues: Say which dynasty the kings belonged to
b1-haromresz-01.target: A Királyi Magyarország királyai a Habsburg-ház tagjai voltak. Az országgyűlések színhelye Pozsony volt.
b1-haromresz-01.english: The kings of Royal Hungary were members of the House of Habsburg. Pozsony was the seat of the diets.
b1-haromresz-01.canDo: I can describe the governance of Royal Hungary under the Habsburg monarchs.

b1-haromresz-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Buda in 1541
b1-haromresz-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what happened to Buda Castle in 1541.
b1-haromresz-02.prompt: Tell the official on which day the Turkish troops took Buda Castle, how they took it and who governed the province afterwards.
cues: Say the date and that the Turks took the castle by a ruse
b1-haromresz-02.target: 1541. augusztus 29-én a török csapatok csellel foglalták el Buda várát. A tartományt a budai pasa irányította.
b1-haromresz-02.english: On 29 August 1541 the Turkish troops took Buda Castle by a ruse. The pasha of Buda governed the province.
b1-haromresz-02.canDo: I can narrate the fall of Buda Castle on August 29, 1541.

b1-haromresz-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Tribute and Autonomy
b1-haromresz-03.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks what the Principality of Transylvania paid to the sultan and what it kept.
b1-haromresz-03.prompt: Tell the official, using bár, that Transylvania paid tribute but stayed independent in its internal affairs, and name its seat.
cues: Say that Transylvania paid tribute to the sultan
Say that it stayed independent in its internal affairs
b1-haromresz-03.target: Bár Erdély adót fizetett a szultánnak, belső ügyeiben önálló maradt. Az Erdélyi Fejedelemség székhelye Gyulafehérvár volt.
b1-haromresz-03.english: Although Transylvania paid tribute to the sultan, it stayed independent in its internal affairs. The seat of the Principality of Transylvania was Gyulafehérvár.
b1-haromresz-03.canDo: I can outline the autonomy of the Principality of Transylvania.

b1-haromresz-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Life at the Border Fortresses
b1-haromresz-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks about life in the border fortresses.
b1-haromresz-04.prompt: Tell the official what the border warriors regularly did and what was the custom between the champions before the fortress walls.
cues: Say what the warriors regularly did
Say what the custom was before the fortress walls
b1-haromresz-04.target: A végvári vitézek rendszeresen portyáztak a határvidéken. A bajnokok között szokás volt a bajvívás a várak falai előtt.
b1-haromresz-04.english: The border fortress warriors regularly raided the borderlands. It was the custom for the champions to fight single combat before the fortress walls.
b1-haromresz-04.canDo: I can describe the daily life, skirmishes (portya), and single combat (bajvívás) of border warriors.

b1-haromresz-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Century and a Half
b1-haromresz-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks how long Hungary was divided and what happened to Buda in 1686.
b1-haromresz-05.prompt: Tell the official how long the division lasted and when the allied armies retook Buda.
cues: Say that the division lasted a century and a half
b1-haromresz-05.target: Magyarország másfél évszázadon keresztül három részből állt. 1686-ban a szövetséges seregek visszafoglalták Budát.
b1-haromresz-05.english: For a century and a half Hungary consisted of three parts. In 1686 the allied armies retook Buda.
b1-haromresz-05.canDo: I can summarize the 150-year era of Hungarian partition from 1541 to 1699.

b1-haromresz-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Three Parts of Hungary
b1-haromresz-consolidation.scenario: At the end of your naturalization interview, the official asks you to name the three parts of Hungary after 1541.
b1-haromresz-consolidation.prompt: Name the three parts and say what the Peace of Karlowitz did in 1699.
cues: Name the three parts of the country
Say what the Peace of Karlowitz did in 1699
b1-haromresz-consolidation.target: Magyarország három részre szakadt: a Királyi Magyarországra, a Hódoltságra és Erdélyre. 1699-ben a karlócai békében a törökök lemondtak az ország nagy részéről.
b1-haromresz-consolidation.english: Hungary split into three parts: Royal Hungary, the Ottoman-ruled territory and Transylvania. In 1699, in the Peace of Karlowitz, the Turks gave up most of the country.
b1-haromresz-consolidation.canDo: I can explain the tripartite division of Hungary: Royal Hungary, Ottoman Hódoltság, and Transylvania.
